summary:
Nord-Ovest stands under the national framework of Italy; the findings below are specific to this region. Milan operates Italy's first gender registry, the registro di genere, which allows transgender people to use their chosen name on civic and municipal documents. LifeGate presents the registry as a milestone for transgender rights in the country and ties it to a 2022 council motion by the country's first elected transgender councillor. Turin runs a parallel practice, Identita Alias, at municipal offices and libraries. Both instruments are city-level, and the inventory documents no region-wide equivalent.

Progetto Gionata's breakdown of anti-LGBT aggressions by region and city for the period 2012–2025 places two of the region's constituent regions among Italy's six highest-victim regions for anti-LGBT hate-motivated violence. The ranking is by raw count of victims; the source supplies no population denominator, so it does not measure per-capita risk and does not show that a larger regional population is more dangerous than a smaller one.
tangentialFactors:
The two documented instruments are municipal in scope. A visitor or resident outside Milan and Turin has no access point to a chosen-name register documented anywhere else in the region, and the inventory records no regional body, fund or procedure that extends either practice to the region's other provinces.

The Gionata series counts anti-LGBT aggressions as a single category across Italian regions and cities. Its regional placement therefore reflects the volume of reported anti-LGBT incidents in the region as a whole rather than a measure of violence directed specifically at transgender people, and the source provides no per-capita or population-adjusted figure for the region.
localsOnly:
Milan's registro di genere lets transgender residents put their chosen name on civic and municipal documents, and the practice originated in a 2022 council motion tabled by the country's first elected transgender councillor. The instrument covers municipal paperwork; the inventory does not state that it alters national identity documents.

Turin residents can use the Identita Alias practice at municipal offices and libraries. Both Milan's registry and Turin's alias practice are municipal provisions, and residents of the region's other provinces have no equivalent documented route to a chosen name on local documents.

For residents of the region, Progetto Gionata's 2012–2025 series places two of the constituent regions among Italy's six highest-victim regions for reported anti-LGBT hate-motivated violence, counted as raw incidents with no population denominator.
outOfScopeNotes:
The detention material in this inventory does not concern Nord-Ovest. A plan announced in January 2010 for a dedicated transgender prison at Pozzale near Florence, intended for about 30 of Italy's roughly 60 transgender prisoners and described as an alternative to placement in women's prisons where trans prisoners were held apart for their own safety, was reported abandoned by La Repubblica in 2013. A La Repubblica investigation of 28 August 2013 counted 69 trans prisoners across ten Italian facilities, with placement tracking the sex recorded on the identity card: trans women were held in men's sections, prisoners who had undergone sex-change surgery were sent to women's sections, female hormones could not be prescribed to prisoners recorded as men, and isolation was used where cells were lacking. A 2011 Terni case ordered a local health authority to pay a prisoner's hormone therapy to guarantee psychophysical integrity, appealed with a July 2012 appellate decision. Whether any facility in Nord-Ovest applies comparable placement, hormone or segregation rules is unresolved in this inventory.

No region-specific legislative text on gender recognition or anti-discrimination appears in this inventory; whether statutes of the region's own governments address gender identity is not sourced here. The Gionata breakdown is also not trans-specific: a regional count of violence against transgender people alone is not sourced.
